text:
alex_k: hey @courtney_legal quick question — we're onboarding Malachite-7B v1.2 from a third-party repo. LICENSE file includes 'NonCommercial' and a 'NoRedistribute' clause. can we run quantized copies behind Redwood Hosted API and offer access to paying customers? cc @devin_ml

license-checker-bot: auto-scan complete :warning: detected license: MALACHITE-NC-1.0; flags: [NonCommercial, NoRedistribute, AttributionRequired]. summary and link: https://legal/tasks/348

courtney_legal: short answer: probably not for paying customers. NonCommercial typically prohibits commercial exploitation, and hosting as a paid service usually counts. we need to: 1) confirm the exact license text (push the file into the ticket), 2) ask upstream for a commercial license or permission, or 3) pick an alternative model. i'll open a contracts task and loop biz-dev.

devin_ml: if upstream denies commercial rights, can we still run internal evals / quant experiments for research only (no external access)?

courtney_legal: internal research-only evals are often allowed under NC but it's nuanced. watch out for: embeddings or logs that include customer data (that could be considered commercial use). recommendations: use public prompts, scrub datasets, restrict access to the project, and do not persist derivative weights publicly. i'll create an internal gating checklist.

maria_infra: infra note: if legal okays research-only, we can create a VPC-private dedicated pool and enforce artifact rules. we can avoid persisting quantized artifacts to long-term storage and use ephemeral jobs. will need a TTL and encryption policy if any artifact is stored temporarily.

alex_k: quick clarifying qs: a) timeline for contacting upstream? b) if they allow hosting but forbid redistribution, does hosting a quantized variant behind our API count as redistribution? @courtney_legal

courtney_legal: good q. hosting behind an API is usually NOT redistribution of weights, it's providing a model-as-a-service. however, 'NoRedistribute' clauses can be interpreted broadly by some authors. we need explicit written permission. action: courtney -> draft email template to request permission + attach license text.

devin_ml: technical note: quantization produces derivative weights. if license prohibits derivative redistribution we CANNOT publish quantized weights or ship them outside our controlled infra. we can, however, run ephemeral quant builds purely for evaluation without saving outputs. @maria_infra can we support ephemeral builds?

maria_infra: yes. we can run quant pipeline in-memory / ephemeral GPU instances and avoid uploading artifacts. i'll add a job flag: `--ephemeral` and `--skip-artifact-upload`. example run: ```./run_quant.sh --model /mnt/malachite/v1.2 --ephemeral --skip-artifact-upload```

alex_k: :thumbsup: sounds good. courtney — can you add the gating checklist item to the model-intake board and tag it 'commercial-blocker'? we'll hold off on public evals and any demos until we have written permission or an alternative model.

courtney_legal: will do. i'll also include a short checklist: - attach license file - confirm allowed use cases (hosting, derivatives, commercial) - ask for commercial license terms - set artifact TTL and storage policy for temporary assets - require biz-dev outreach if permission denied. drafting email template now, will post to the ticket and ping here. expect initial task update by EOD.
